prompt: flatten() only walks dicts, so lists come through as raw values and empty dicts silently disappear from the output. Make it descend into lists using the index as the key segment (`{"a": [{"b": 1}]}` -> `{"a.0.b": 1}`) and keep empty dicts/lists as leaf values instead of dropping them. unflatten() should be the inverse, rebuilding a list wherever the keys at a level are exactly 0..n-1.
